entities.summary: Lardarius Webb is an American former professional football player who was a cornerback in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Nicholls State Colonels and the Southern Miss Golden Eagles. Webb was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the third round of the 2009 NFL draft.
